_doc: Nevada Nights through Lake Murray v4's engine (ledger 0078: the old quality bar, ported to check that nothing gets worse). The line, widths and 3DEP are tracks/exotics-racing-lv's (installed 0.8.0), read by tools/lm_engine_intake.py; the profile is the measured one with the elevation stage's grade cap undone; the camber is the G10 lidar survey (source/lidar/camber-survey/crossfall.json, branch claude/lidar-camber-survey); the edge is the circuit's (no curb, no sidewalk). Every other key is the live track's, copied; the live config is untouched.
name: Nevada Nights (LM engine)

location._note: Centroid of the traced lap. The circuit sits in the LVMS lots north-west of the drag strip, between I-15 (north) and Speedway Blvd (south-west); the Welcome Center is at 36.28087, -115.02109 on its south-west corner. Closed 2021-11-28; the ground went to Nuro (DOSSIER.md section 0).

scenery._note: Mojave lot track: no trees, sparse low scrub only (DOSSIER section 6 / QA 6).

bespoke._doc: .claude/skills/bespoke-assets, placed by tools/author_bespoke_blend.py into AUTH_bespoke. Kevin's dressing call (DOSSIER section 11): as in 2013, the two south-west buildings, no Welcome Center.

buildings._source: Footprint read off USDA NAIP 2013-09-28 (1 m native, z18 = 0.481 m/px; source/trace/buildings_2013_measured.png, red): 29.3 x 26.0 m. Wall height: the north-west shadow is 3.2-3.9 m wide across that wall. Sun: shadow azimuth about 302 deg off the lot poles gives about 09:30 PDT, elevation 33 deg (scripts/lighting/solar.py), so 2.3-2.8 m; 3.0 taken, the imagery's own 1 m pixel covers the difference. White roof, no ridge shadow: flat [roof form read, not measured]. Fabric walls [invented]: a 2013 visitor's account has the cars under a tent (detailedimage.com), no photo of this building found.

Footprint as above (blue): 54.1 x 20.4 m, the ridge along the long axis, plain in the roof's two shades. Eave: the shadow is 2.6-3.4 m wide, 1.9-2.4 m by the same sun; 2.6 taken as the lowest door height a car hall needs [invented within the imagery's 1 m pixel]. Ridge: the two roof shades give a pitch of at least about 9 deg; 15 deg taken [invented], a usual clearspan tent.

cones._source: DOSSIER section 5 [S19]: cones at the braking point, apex and exit of every corner. NAIP does not resolve them: positions by the rule in tools/plan_cones.py, every number there [invented].

scrub._source: Polygon: the undisturbed strip north of the lap on NAIP 2019-07-06 (DOSSIER section 6: native scrub only beyond the campus edge, confirmed in the imagery). Count: 36 dark clumps counted in it (brightness at least 28 under the polygon's median, 3-60 px), median about 1.3 m across. Heights by the species (creosote about 1-2 m here, bursage half that) [from the plant's habit, not measured]; the scatter is seeded, not the real plants.

source._control_points_note: Exact, not pinned: the two image corners' lon/lat come from the NAIP tile georeference (Web Mercator z18, tile x0/y0 recorded in source/trace/README.md). Over this 0.6 km crop the north-up affine differs from Web Mercator by under 1 cm.
source._note: Traced 2026-10-28 off USDA NAIP 2019-07-06 (0.6 m native, public domain; scene nv_m_3611548_se_11_060_20190706_20191118, Microsoft Planetary Computer tiles at z18 = 0.481 m/px), the only vintage with sub-metre detail inside the track's 2015-2021 life (2015 and 2017 are 1 m; 2022 is Nuro-era). Hand seeds (source/trace/seeds.json) along the rubbered lap, then each 1 m station re-centred between the two painted edge lines by perpendicular scans (source/trace/refine_trace.py), widths measured line-to-line, floored at 11.5 m where a joining connector or the pit lane stole a line, capped 20 m, smoothed over 11 m. Width mean 14.0 m (11.6 on the straight, 15-19.5 at corner exits). Lap 1,828 m vs the published '1.2 mi' (1,931 m), -5.3 %: outside the dossier's 3 % check, but this georeference is the photo's own (no pinned control points to be wrong), so the published figure is taken as rounded up from about 1.14 mi. The straight (NW corner exit to the T1 kink) is about 470 m vs the published 1,800 ft (549 m); same reading. Unused pavement in the photo (later layouts over this kn5): the two inner loops off the straight and the S, the pit lane round the Welcome Center, the karting/skid area west of it.
source._note_2013: Layout unchanged 2013-2019: USDA NAIP 2013-09-28 (1 m, scene nv_m_3611548_se_11_1_20130928_20131122) shows this same circuit already paved, edge-lined and kerbed, and the 2019 trace sits on its asphalt all the way round (source/trace/trace_on_2013.jpg). Kevin drove it in 2013. What changed by 2019 is the buildings: in 2013 two smaller buildings stood where the 2015 Welcome Center + covered pit are. The dossier's 'parking lot with tents' (2013) describes the facilities, not the track.

road_profile._doc: Only T2 is banked: 6.0 deg = 10.5 %, measured by USGS 3DEP lidar (+10.0..+11.2 % across +/-5 m) and matching the published 11 % 'high speed banked bowl' [DOSSIER S4/S20]. Window from the lidar, not the curvature: superelevation builds over ~80 m off the straight (2.6 % at s 222 -> 10 % at s 303), holds through the corner, runs out over ~80 m down the east side (10.2 % at s 441 -> 2.4 % at s 522). Raised-cosine ramps 85 m. Positive = right-hander, outside (left) edge up (profile.py). Every other corner flat (L10). Not modelled: the ~2 % crossfall the lidar reads everywhere else, falling to the infield (left edge up) all the way round.
road_profile._ribbon_cols_doc: 8 lateral columns so the bank ramps' twist doesn't sag the deck between 3 m rows (v0.1.0 drive_test: 28 severe steps of up to 13 cm, all in the old 20 m ramps). ribbon.road_ribbon cols.
road_profile._sign_doc: POSITIVE: profile.py's +ve banks a right-hander (frame-left / outside edge up) and T2 is a real right-hander driven clockwise. It was -6.0 while this config carried the V1 OBJ program's mirror_x (which swaps frame-left and right); the chain's frame is San Diego's, mirror_x false (ledger 0060, 2026-10-29), so the sign is the natural one. Check on the built deck: the OUTSIDE (left, east-side) edge of T2 must be the raised one.

route._orientation_doc: CLOCKWISE, inferred (not yet seen on onboard video): the published 'Turn 2 = high-speed banked bowl at the end of the long straight' fits only the NE corner, which is the end of the 470 m I-15 straight when it is raced north-east; the pit exit (the rubbered lane round the Welcome Center's east side) merges heading north-west onto the west side just before the NW corner, the same sense. S/F about 145 m up the straight from the NW corner exit. Lap: straight NE -> T1 kink -> T2 bowl (right, banked) -> east side S -> SE right -> west under the inner loop -> S -> long left-hand U (hairpin) south of it -> north past the Welcome Center -> NW corner -> straight.

edge._doc: the circuit edge (ledger 0078): no curb, no sidewalk (neither track has one). The asphalt edge is held at road height for 0.30 m and the run-off ground meets it 0.15 m lower over 1.0 m [invented: the flush meet the drive gate reads as no drop]; the ground beyond is the assembler's conform to the road (20 m + 16 m blend), then the 3DEP surface: the real run-off level. Racing kerbs and paved run-off are NOT built: no measured kerb line or run-off outline is committed for either track (owed: read off the NAIP / lidar).

route._kerbs_doc: the racing kerbs traced off the aerial (tracks/exotics-racing-lv/source/edges/kerbs.json: imagery, method, the eye check); built by tools/author_kerbs_blend.py outside the lane edge, the config's kerb profile
